criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 779 identifies 'Lds Institute of Religion' at 14 WALDRON ST.; the Church locator evidence distinguishes 14 Waldron from the separate 3224 Jasper meetinghouse. Structural shell's four lower XY vertices match the transformed GIS ring in order; maximum vertex residual 0.000016 m.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Asset is a massing library retaining campus-world coordinates under identity transform, as its manifest contract specifies. The long and short shell axes follow the GIS ring; measured shell dimensions from that ring are approximately 32.51 m by 17.97 m. The shell registration is exact to the project transform.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: GIS records NUM_LEVELS=1; the July 2023 Street View visibly supports a single-story, low-roof building and a small higher reddish roof behind it. The asset has a 4.15 m body, 5.45 m main ridge, and 5.90 m secondary ridge, but these are estimates from one unscaled, oblique and partly occluded image; GIS 'Extrution: 12' has undocumented units.
findings: No scaled elevation, survey, or measured height evidence supports any modeled Z dimension.
The secondary roof's plan and pitch are inferred from a narrow visible strip; exact roof silhouette remains unverified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Street View supports red-brown brick, a low dark eave, a broad glazed/recessed entrance, ramp/steps, and several openings. The mesh includes these general elements, but the generated straight-on render places the entrance near the middle of the long elevation and shows four regular small windows; the oblique source photo shows a substantially off-center entry and a more recessed, columned/glazed front zone. Exact window count and spacing are explicitly estimates.
findings: Facade composition is only approximate: entrance placement/glazing and window pattern do not convincingly reproduce the visible source arrangement.
No visual evidence supports hidden elevations or the exact trim/material boundaries; the archive finding aid lists photos but the photos were not obtained.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Blender reopened massing_the_church_of_jesus_christ_of_latter_day_saints_6f2a451.blend in 5.2.3 LTS; expected scene and collection exist, the collection has 1 object(s), and the mesh has 400 vertices / 285 polygons with 9 named materials. No modifiers, external libraries, or image dependencies are present. Source register, raw GIS snapshot, Street View image, source notes, build/reopen records, and three renders are present.
findings: Shared manifest bounds remain stale (Z max 16.0 m versus reopened mesh max 5.9 m); coordinator-owned index needs reconciliation before final integration.
The Purdue Archives references are catalog leads only; source images remain unavailable, and the Street View evidence is one oblique view.
